title: Hazard Premium-Change Loading When a Summit Reserve's Hazard Bill Is Withdrawn
content:
In a review of the hazard insurance bills of a Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve under Set-Aside Accounts, a withdrawn hazard bill compared with the bills that took its place sets the hazard premium-change loading. The hazard bills of the review are the hazard insurance bills on file for the reserve received no later than the review date and fewer than 12 whole calendar months before it.

**Rule.**
- Where at least one of the hazard bills of the review is withdrawn and the paid and received hazard bills of the review sum to more than the withdrawn hazard bills of the review increased by the premium-change threshold percentage of 10.0 percent, the loading is the high premium-change loading, 8.0 percent.
- Where at least one is withdrawn and the paid and received hazard bills sum to more than the withdrawn hazard bills but not more than that threshold, the loading is the low premium-change loading, 4.0 percent.
- Otherwise this rule adds no premium-change loading.

**Boundaries on a hypothetical withdrawn total of 1,000.00** (threshold point 1,100.00):

| Paid and received hazard bills of the review | Loading |
|---|---|
| 1,100.01 | 8.0 percent |
| 1,100.00 | 4.0 percent |
| 1,000.01 | 4.0 percent |
| 1,000.00 or less | None under this rule |
